Once a continuation RUN exists, never create ADMISSION_FAILURE for that attempt; preserve existing semantics that a persisted RESULT followed by transport failure is not rewritten as FAILURE. Add a regression that forces REPAIR transport failure after RESULT persistence and proves no admission diagnostic or category conversion occurs.
finding.issue: F1 is resolved: remediation lineage rejection now preserves the exact observed remediation ref identity needed to close the TASK-166-style forensic gap, without adding a second remote query or weakening fail-closed validation. The unaffected F2 remains: REPAIR exception handling emits Admission Failure v2 in the else branch whenever the continuation RUN has a persisted RESULT. Runtime persists RESULT before attempting post-PASS transport, so a transport failure after RESULT persistence can still be misclassified as ADMISSION_FAILURE for an attempt that already owns a canonical RUN.
